rows.name: Main bot
rows.rule: The main bot: owns a coin while it is above its 200-day trend line. Checks Tuesdays.

rows.name: Fast trend
rows.rule: Like the main bot, but a faster 50-day line, checked daily.

rows.name: Coin rotation
rows.rule: Every Tuesday holds the 3 strongest of 10 coins (last 28 days), only if they are in an uptrend.

rows.name: Calm sizing
rows.rule: Holds BTC + ETH but less of them when prices swing wildly.

rows.name: Buy the dip
rows.rule: Buys sharp short dips in an uptrend, sells after the bounce.

rows.name: Breakout bot
rows.rule: Buys a 20-day high, sells a 10-day low.

rows.name: Just hold
rows.rule: Buys 50% BTC + 50% ETH once and never sells. The yardstick.

rows.name: Golden cross
rows.rule: Owns a coin while its 50-day average is above its 200-day average.

rows.name: Day trader
rows.rule: Day trader: buys in the evening if the coin rose that day, sells at midnight.
